patches.reason: Legacy bug (creator report), uncertain patch: in ashleyweeklyspank's corner time, the cooldown tone with attitude <= 30 sets cornertime = "kneeling" without setting cornertimeMins, so the corner message read cornertimeMins as the stored value, which a reset (save("Banjo.ashley.cornertimeMins", null)) clears, and Groovy failed at cornertimeMins * 60 (V2 explorer: TSR027). Every other position sets its minutes, so the intent of some duration is evident; its amount is not: the patch uses the cooldown's other duration (getRandom(4)+2 + cornertimeBonus), which may deviate from what the author meant for this harsher case.
